summary: Unofficial simulator of PayDunya's redirect payment: invoice creation, payment status check and IPN.
notes: Built from PayDunya's public HTTP/JSON page only, which carries no version or date: the version shown is the consultation date.
Replace https://app.paydunya.com/sandbox-api/v1/ with the simulator's address: paths stay /checkout-invoice/create and /checkout-invoice/confirm/{token}.
Your Overpass test key goes in the PAYDUNYA-PRIVATE-KEY header; PAYDUNYA-MASTER-KEY and PAYDUNYA-TOKEN are accepted whatever their value.

The hash is the SHA-512 of the MasterKey, as documented. In the IPN, the MasterKey is the secret shown on the track for your key; send that secret in PAYDUNYA-MASTER-KEY so confirm returns the same hash.

The IPN is posted as application/x-www-form-urlencoded, fields under data with brackets (data[invoice][token]), as the documentation's PHP example reads them; the exact encoding is not described there.

Scenarios give the documented statuses: completed for success, failed for insufficient funds (empty fail_reason, the documentation only fills it for card payments), pending with no IPN for the timeout.
The IPN goes to the target chosen on the test track, not to actions.callback_url.
The documentation only describes the success code 00: the simulator's refusals carry codes OVP-400, OVP-401, OVP-404 and OVP-429, which are not PayDunya's.
receipt_url points to a simulator page, not a PDF receipt; the default customer is made up.
Payment and redistribution (direct-pay/credit-account) is not simulated.

endpoints.POST /sandbox-api/v1/checkout-invoice/cr: Create an invoice and get the payment address

steps.invoice: Create a 5,000 FCFA invoice with your test key.
steps.confirm: Check the invoice status: the virtual payer acted according to the scenario.
